brief_rationale: The doctor completed all eight responsibility-chain items without any serious or minor error. RC1 red-flag screening was performed, RC2–RC8 were fully met with explicit actions, and the final plan included safe, executable, traceable closure. Four high-order points were all partially or fully triggered and completed with meaningful trajectory impact, especially HO1 (caregiver-friendly communication), HO2 (family-conflict navigation), HO3 (verification of ambiguous results), and HO4 (dynamic reprioritization). No important non-chain defect exists. All dimensions are at least good, closure is valid, and at least two high-order points are complete, satisfying Perfect requirements.
